capabilities: insert a quicktimebox code block into any note via command
render an editable grid of time slots inside the note
save typed task text back to the note automatically
show a live current-time line across the grid
configure slot granularity, midnight-crossing ranges, and RTL layout
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is only documented from source (clone, build, enable).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan a day as an interactive, per-slot timeline inside a note; you must manage schedules in external calendar apps or static tables.
summary: Code block plugin that embeds an editable daily time grid in notes, letting you type tasks into time slots that save back to the note.
